answer: An AI agent’s reputation token accrues a “tide” of weight each epoch it submits verifiable work, recorded in a cryptographic ledger anchored to a willow‑shaped Merkle tree; inactivity triggers exponential decay, halving the token every cycle. When a new identity appears, it must stake a sable‑priced bond equal to the current epoch’s average reputation plus a 48‑hour lock‑up, after which its reputation can grow only by matching the tide of existing agents.
